title: Minor bug : NS v3 tab / secret API option
body:
NSv3 doesn't need the Secret API but uses a token.

If I open the NS menu, I see only the token line (normal)

![Screenshot_20230118_175801_AAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/213247171-bd126f3d-ab92-4581-be7e-f58dfbb1fd68.jpg)

But if I tap another line and then _back_, the Secret API line is shown...

![Screenshot_20230118_175822_AAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/213247437-0a37db84-96c8-4250-ae1c-e4c475ca8f42.jpg)
